retrievalProfile.description: A vintage 1970s soul aesthetic featuring nested rectangular frames that create a tunnel effect around a central group photograph.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square album cover featuring a central black-and-white photograph of a group, surrounded by multiple concentric, nested rectangular borders in varying shades of beige, tan, and muted rose, creating a receding perspective. The title is mirrored at the top and bottom in a stylized Art Deco font.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric rectangles create a depth-of-field tunnel effect
Mirrored typography balances the top and bottom margins
Muted earth tones contrast with a vibrant purple vinyl record
Central photographic focal point anchored by geometric repetition
coreInvariants: Muted sepia and tan color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A small rectangular group photo is centered as the innermost element of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central photograph serves as the primary anchor, reinforced by the converging lines of the frames.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the outer typography inward through the layers of frames to the central image.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The outer beige border provides a clean margin for the display typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Beige and tan (background and outer frames)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted rose and brown (inner frames and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant purple (vinyl record and hype sticker)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the main artwork with high value contrast in the typography; high saturation in the physical media.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has a distinct vertical elongation
The 'M' and 'N' have sharp, geometric vertices
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both header and footer to maintain symmetry.
graphicDevices: Film strip contact sheet background on inner sleeve

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-waisted, geometric Art Deco feel.
Captures the period-accurate display style, though heavier.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square layout with a series of 5-6 nested rectangular frames in shades of beige, tan, and muted rose, leading to a central black-and-white vintage group photograph.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply Art Deco display text in dark brown at the top and bottom margins, ensuring the bottom text is a mirrored placement but remains upright.

verificationChecks: Are the frames concentric and centered?
Is the typography high-waisted Art Deco?
Is the color palette limited to muted earth tones?
Is the bottom text upright and centered?

mustRedesign: Specific song titles on the sticker
postGenerationChecks: Verify text is dark brown and legible
Ensure the central photo is grayscale or sepia
Confirm the overall square aspect ratio
recipe.reuseFormula: Nested [Color Palette] Rectangles + [Art Deco Font] Mirrored Header/Footer + Central [Subject] Photo
